translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi jatich Jehova Nyasaye.

content.text: An-gi wach e chunya mowuok kuom Nyasaye,
kuom gima joricho timo:
Ok giluoro Nyasaye
kata matin.
Nikech chunye wuonde kendo owuondore kende,
chunye wuonde ma ok onyal neno richone mosin-go.
Weche mawuok e dhoge richo kendo gin miriambo;
oseweyo bedo mariek kod timo maber.
Kata konindo e kitandane, to ochano timo gima rach;
oseketo chunye mar luwo yor richo,
kendo ok otamre gima rach.
Herani ochopo nyaka e polo malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
adierani chopo nyaka e polo,
Timni makare chalo gi gode madongo,
ratiro mari chalo gi kut matut.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in ema irito ngima dhano gi le.
Mano kaka herani ma ok rum nengone tek, yaye Nyasaye!
Joma idewo kaachiel gi joma ni piny
yudo kar pondo margi e bwo tipo mar bwombeni.
Gichamo chiemo mangʼeny e hekalu mari ka gimor;
imiyogi math moa e aorani mar mor.
Nimar in ema in gi soko mar pi mar ngima;
kuom lerni ema wanenoe ler.
Med nyiso herani ni joma ongʼeyi,
med nyiso timni makare ne joma gie chunygi ni kare.
Mad tiend joma sungore kik nyona,
kata lwet joma timbegi richo gola kama antie.
Neye kaka joma timo gik maricho oriere piny kopodho
osedirgi piny ma ok ginyal aa malo!
